```{r setup, include=FALSE}
## Global options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
```

# Objectives 

To assess the validity of primary and hospital care resource use and costs estimated based on OMOP-mapped CPRD data against its corresponding source data using a cohort of women with postmenopausal fragility fractures in the UK.

The cohort of interest is made of women aged >50 years with an incident fragility fracture in any site except the face, skull or digits and no history of fracture in the two years prior. The outcomes of interest are *primary* and *secondary healthcare resource utilisation* and *direct costs* associated to first incident fracture measured during the 730 days post index date or until a censoring event occurs and expressed as values per person/year. A detailed analysis plan for this study is available [here](https://github.com/LucyNjokiNjuki/OMOP-Validation-Study/raw/refs/heads/main/Analysis_plan_V.2_final.docx).

This RMarkdown reports the data preparation and results for the analysis conducted on the *source CPRD-HES* dataset. 

# Data Preparation

The attrition table below shows the steps we followed to clean and prepare the data for the analysis.

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(here)
library(rio)
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(gt)
library(rvest)
library(DT)
library(png)
library(grid)
library(patchwork)
library(gridExtra)
```

## Attrition Report {.tabset}

```{r}
# Import and preprocess the raw attrition report
attrition_report_raw <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "AttritionReportCoh_Raw.xlsx")) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.) | . == "NA", "", .))) %>% 
  mutate(
    subjects_excluded = as.numeric(subjects_excluded),  
    number_subjects = as.numeric(number_subjects),
    records_excluded = as.numeric(records_excluded)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    percent_excluded = ifelse(!is.na(lag(number_subjects)) & lag(number_subjects) != 0, 
                              round((subjects_excluded / lag(number_subjects)) * 100, 2), 
                              0)
  ) %>%
  select(reason, number_records, number_subjects, subjects_excluded, percent_excluded, records_excluded)

# Import and preprocess the OMOP attrition report
attrition_report_omop <- import(here("OMOP Analysis", "Results", "AttritionReportCoh_OMOP.xlsx")) %>% 
  mutate(
    subjects_excluded = as.numeric(subjects_excluded),  
    number_subjects = as.numeric(number_subjects),
    records_excluded = as.numeric(records_excluded)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    percent_excluded = ifelse(!is.na(lag(number_subjects)) & lag(number_subjects) != 0, 
                              round((subjects_excluded / lag(number_subjects)) * 100, 2), 
                              0)
  ) %>%
  select(reason, number_records, number_subjects, subjects_excluded, percent_excluded, records_excluded)

# Merge datasets with suffixes
merged_attrition <- full_join(attrition_report_raw, attrition_report_omop, by = "reason", suffix = c("_raw", "_omop"))

# Reorder: move the last 2 rows to the top
reordered_attrition <- merged_attrition %>%
  {
    top_two <- tail(., 2)
    middle <- head(., -2)
    bind_rows(top_two[2,], top_two[1,], middle)
  }

# Add indentation for visual grouping
reordered_attrition <- reordered_attrition %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  mutate(
    reason = case_when(
      row_id == 1 ~ "Starting Population - Female individuals",
      row_id == 2 ~ "Anyone With Fracture(s)",
      TRUE ~ paste0("  ", reason)
    )
  )

# Get eligible patient counts from the relevant row
eligible_counts <- reordered_attrition %>%
  filter(reason == "  Exclude patients with less than one month of exposure") %>%
  select(number_subjects_raw, number_subjects_omop)

# Add final row for eligible patients
reordered_attrition <- reordered_attrition %>%
  bind_rows(
    tibble(
      reason = "Number of eligible patients",
      number_subjects_raw = eligible_counts$number_subjects_raw,
      number_subjects_omop = eligible_counts$number_subjects_omop,
      subjects_excluded_raw = NA,
      percent_excluded_raw = NA,
      records_excluded_raw = NA,
      subjects_excluded_omop = NA,
      percent_excluded_omop = NA,
      records_excluded_omop = NA,
      row_id = max(reordered_attrition$row_id) + 1
    )
  )

# Create the gt table
reordered_attrition %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Attrition Table**")
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    heading.align = "left",
    table.font.size = px(14)
  ) %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 3) %>%

  fmt_number(
    columns = c(contains("number_records"), contains("number_subjects"), 
                contains("subjects_excluded"), contains("records_excluded")), 
    sep_mark = ",",  
    decimals = 0  
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = contains("percent_excluded"),  
    sep_mark = ",",  
    decimals = 2  
  ) %>%
  sub_missing(
    columns = everything(), 
    missing_text = ""  
  ) %>%

  cols_label(
    reason = "Reason for exclusion",
    number_records_raw = "Number of Records Included",
    number_subjects_raw = "Number of Subjects Included",
    subjects_excluded_raw = "N Subjects Excluded",
    percent_excluded_raw = "Perc Subjects Excluded (%)",
    records_excluded_raw = "N Records Excluded",
    number_records_omop = "Number of Records Included",
    number_subjects_omop = "Number of Subjects Included",
    subjects_excluded_omop = "N Subjects Excluded",
    percent_excluded_omop = "Perc Subjects Excluded (%)",
    records_excluded_omop = "N Records Excluded"
  ) %>%

  tab_spanner(
    label = "CPRD Raw Analysis",
    columns = c(number_records_raw, number_subjects_raw, 
                subjects_excluded_raw, percent_excluded_raw, 
                records_excluded_raw)
    ) %>%
  
  tab_spanner(
    label = "OMOP Analysis",
    columns = c(number_records_omop, number_subjects_omop, 
                subjects_excluded_omop, percent_excluded_omop, 
                records_excluded_omop)
  ) %>%

  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = reason,
      rows = row_id %in% c(1,19)  # Use the precomputed row_id
    )
  ) %>% 
  
  cols_hide(
    columns = c(
      row_id
    )
  )
```


# Results 

## Table 1

```{r}
# Import data
table1_data_raw <- rio::import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Table1_Raw.xlsx")) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "", .)))

table1_data_omop <- rio::import(here("OMOP Analysis", "Results", "Table1_OMOP.xlsx")) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "", .)))

# Define subcategories for indentation
parent_vars <- c("Fracture Site", "Censoring Event",
                 "Heathcare Service User Status", "Heathcare Service Non-user Visit Status") 

subcategories <- c("Hip", "Vertebra", "NHNV", 
                   "Cancer", "Cancer, Fracture ensuing incident (index) fracture",
                   "Death", "End of data collection period",
                   "End of data collection period, Cancer",
                   "End of data collection period, Fracture ensuing incident (index) fracture",
                   "Fracture ensuing incident (index) fracture",
                   "Max of 730 days from index date",
                   "Max of 730 days from index date, Cancer",
                   "Max of 730 days from index date, End of data collection period",
                   "Max of 730 days from index date, Fracture ensuing incident (index) fracture",
                   "Max of 730 days from index date, Paget’s disease of the bone, or other metabolic bone diseases",
                   "Paget’s disease of the bone, or other metabolic bone diseases", 
                   "Cancer, Paget’s disease of the bone, or other metabolic bone diseases", 
                   "Paget’s disease of the bone, or other metabolic bone diseases, Fracture ensuing incident (index) fracture", 
                   "Non-User", "User", "Unknown Visits",
                   "No Visits", "Visits with Non-clinically Relevant Staff")


# Merge datasets
merged_data <- full_join(table1_data_raw, table1_data_omop, by = "Variable", suffix = c("_raw", "_omop")) %>% 
   mutate(Variable = case_when(
    Variable %in% subcategories ~ paste0("&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;", Variable), # Indent subcategories using HTML space
    TRUE ~ Variable
  )) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "", .)))

merged_data %>% 
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Patient Characteristics**")
  ) %>%
  opt_all_caps() %>% 
  tab_options(
    heading.align = "left",
    table.font.size = px(14)
  ) %>%
  fmt_markdown(columns = "Variable") %>%  # Apply markdown formatting for indentation
  opt_stylize(style = 3) %>%

  # Add spanner headers for CPRD Raw and OMOP Analysis
  tab_spanner(
    label = "CPRD Raw Analysis",
    columns = c("N = 24,740")
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "OMOP Analysis",
    columns = c("N = 23,957")
  ) %>%


  # Add footnotes
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Median (Q1, Q3); n (%)",
    locations = cells_title(groups = "title")
  ) %>% 
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = md("*User defined as subjects with >=1 visit with a clinically relevant healthcare provider and Non-User as Subjects with no visits, or visits with non-clinically relevant healthcare provider, or unknown specialty*"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = Variable, rows = c(21))
  )


```


## Plots {.tabset}

### Exposure Time

Figure 1: Exposure time

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=6}
# Read images
Exposure_Time_Raw <- readPNG(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Plots", "Exposure_Time.PNG"))
Exposure_Time_OMOP <- readPNG(here("OMOP Analysis", "Results", "Plots", "Exposure_Time.PNG"))

# Wrap them in rasterGrob
Exposure_Time_Raw_g <- rasterGrob(Exposure_Time_Raw, interpolate = TRUE)
Exposure_Time_OMOP_g <- rasterGrob(Exposure_Time_OMOP, interpolate = TRUE)

# Add titles with arrangeGrob 
Exposure_Time_Raw_g_with_title <- arrangeGrob(Exposure_Time_Raw_g, top = textGrob("Source Raw", gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"))) 
Exposure_Time_OMOP_g_with_title <- arrangeGrob(Exposure_Time_OMOP_g, top = textGrob("OMOP", gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"))) 

grid.arrange(Exposure_Time_Raw_g_with_title, Exposure_Time_OMOP_g_with_title, ncol = 2)

```

### HCRU Year 1/2 Summary Tables

```{r}
# Add a column to identify the source

  mutate(Source = "Raw")

yearly_all_visits_only_rp_omop <- import(here("OMOP Analysis", "Results", "Output_yearly_visits_OMOP.xlsx"), sheet = "all_summary_visits") %>%
  mutate(Source = "OMOP")

# Combine the data
yearly_combined_visits_rp <- bind_rows(yearly_all_visits_only_rp_raw, yearly_all_visits_only_rp_omop) %>% 
  select(Source, everything())

# Step 3: Create the gt table
yearly_combined_visits_rp %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**All Patients - Visits Per Patient Per Year 1 & 2**"),
    subtitle = md("*Healthcare Service Users and Non-users*")

  opt_all_caps() %>% 
  tab_options(
    table.width = px(800),
    heading.align = "left",
    table.font.size = px(14)

  opt_stylize(style = 3) %>% 
  cols_label(
    Source = "Data Source",
    mean_visit_count = "Mean Visits Per Year",
    min_visits = "Minimum Visits Per Year",
    max_visits = "Maximum Visits Per Year",
    sd_visits = "SD Visits Per Year",
    median_visits = "Median Visits Per Year",
    q1_visits = "Lower Quartile Visits Per Year",
    q3_visits = "Upper Quartile Visits Per Year"
  )

```

## Costs {.tabset}

### Costs Figures - Monthly

Figure 1: Mean number of primary care consultation costs by provider specialty, users-only.

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=7}
# Read images
Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_Raw <- readPNG(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Plots", "Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted.PNG"))
Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_OMOP <- readPNG(here("OMOP Analysis", "Results", "Plots", "Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted.PNG"))

# Wrap them in rasterGrob
Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_Raw_g <- rasterGrob(Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_Raw, interpolate = TRUE)
Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_OMOP_g <- rasterGrob(Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_OMOP, interpolate = TRUE)

# Add titles with arrangeGrob 
Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_Raw_g_with_title <- arrangeGrob(Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_Raw_g, top = textGrob("Source Raw", gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"))) 
Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_OMOP_g_with_title <- arrangeGrob(Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_OMOP_g, top = textGrob("OMOP", gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"))) 

grid.arrange(Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_Raw_g_with_title, Mean_costs_per_specialty_unweighted_OMOP_g_with_title, ncol = 2)

```

Figure 2: Exposure-weighted mean number of primary care consultations costs by provider specialty, users-only.

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=7}
# Read images
Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_Raw <- readPNG(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Plots", "Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted.PNG"))
Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_OMOP <- readPNG(here("OMOP Analysis", "Results", "Plots", "Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted.PNG"))

# Wrap them in rasterGrob
Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_Raw_g <- rasterGrob(Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_Raw, interpolate = TRUE)
Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_OMOP_g <- rasterGrob(Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_OMOP, interpolate = TRUE)

# Add titles with arrangeGrob 
Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_Raw_g_with_title <- arrangeGrob(Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_Raw_g, top = textGrob("Source Raw", gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"))) 
Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_OMOP_g_with_title <- arrangeGrob(Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_OMOP_g, top = textGrob("OMOP", gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"))) 

grid.arrange(Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_Raw_g_with_title, Mean_costs_per_specialty_weighted_OMOP_g_with_title, ncol = 2)

```

### Costs Year 1/2 Summary Tables

```{r}
# Add a column to identify the source
yearly_all_costs_only_rp_raw <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Output_yearly_costs_Raw.xlsx"), sheet = "all_summary_costs") %>%
  mutate(Source = "Raw")

yearly_all_costs_only_rp_omop <- import(here("OMOP Analysis", "Results", "Output_yearly_costs_OMOP.xlsx"), sheet = "all_summary_costs") %>%
  mutate(Source = "OMOP")

# Combine the data
yearly_combined_costs_rp <- bind_rows(yearly_all_costs_only_rp_raw, yearly_all_costs_only_rp_omop) %>% 
  select(Source, everything())

# Create the gt table
yearly_combined_costs_rp %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**All Patients - Visit Costs Per Patient Per Year 1 & 2**"),
    subtitle = md("*Healthcare Service Users and Non-users*")
  ) %>%
  opt_all_caps() %>% 
  tab_options(
    table.width = px(800),
    heading.align = "left",
    table.font.size = px(14)
  ) |> 
  opt_stylize(style = 3) %>% 
  cols_label(
    Source = "Data Source",
    mean_visits_cost = "Mean Visit Costs per Year",
    min_visits_cost = "Minimum Visit Costs per Year",
    max_visits_cost = "Maximum Visit Costs per Year",
    sd_visits_cost = "SD Visit Costs per Year",
    median_visits_cost = "Median Visit Costs per Year",
    q1_visits_cost = "Lower Quartile Visit Costs per Year",
    q3_visits_cost = "Upper Quartile Visit Costs per Year"
  )

```

### HCRU by Monthly (Unweighted) - Users

```{r}
monthly_visits_users_summary_rp_unweighted_raw <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Output_monthly_visits_Raw.xlsx"), sheet = "monthly_visit_unweighted")
```


```{r}
colnames(monthly_visits_users_summary_rp_unweighted_raw) <- c("Month After Index",  "Mean Visits Per Month", "Minimum Visits Per Month", "Maximum Visits Per Month", "SD Visits Per Month", "Lower Quartile Visits Per Month", "Higher Quartile Visits Per Month", "Number of Subjects")


datatable(monthly_visits_users_summary_rp_unweighted_raw,
    rownames = FALSE, 
    filter = 'top', 
    options = list(
        scrollX = TRUE,  # Allow user to scroll wide tables horizontally
        search = list(regex = FALSE, caseInsensitive = TRUE),
        autoWidth = TRUE,  # Automatically adjust column widths
        columnDefs = list(
          list(targets = c(0, 1, 2), width = "120px"),  # Narrow columns
            list(targets = c(3, 4), width = "300px", className = "text-wrap"), # Wider columns
            list(
                targets = "_all",  # Apply to all columns
                className = "dt-center"  # Center align all columns
            )
        ),
        initComplete = JS(
            "function(settings, json) {",
            "$(this.api().table().body()).css({'font-family': 'Times New Roman', 'font-size': '16px'});",
            "}"
        )
    )
)
```
